description:
Monitor CheckMK hosts and services on the go
Unofficial CheckMK Monitoring is an app that connects to your CheckMK monitoring server.

It shows the current status of your hosts and services and recent events, and notifies you when states change – also in the background.

Key features:
- Dashboard overview of hosts and services
- Multiple CheckMK servers and starred items
- Acknowledge, comment and schedule downtimes from the app
- Problem notifications that stay until the problem is solved
- Quick actions in notifications: acknowledge, comment, recheck
- Event console for recent service events
- Optional Android home screen widget
- Light and dark theme support

Requirements:
- A CheckMK Raw Edition (CRE) or Enterprise Edition (CEE) server
